description.value: Shizen Ya is a Japanese restaurant specializing in brown rice sushi and claims to be the first natural food Japanese restaurant chain in North America to serve sushi exclusively with brown rice. Located in downtown Vancouver on Hornby Street since December 2009, it sources Ocean Wise certified locally-caught wild seafood from the local fish market, with a focus on natural flavors and organic ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down menu with strong vegan and gluten-free options.
